patches.name: Dark Theme
patches.description: Adds an option to enable a dark theme across native UI and supported public WebViews, preserving brand colors and media.

patches.name: Replace Videos with My purchases
patches.description: Replaces the Videos tab with the native My purchases tab and places it in the center. Keeps the cart tab and its badge.
